<p align="center"><strong>Ring the bell for the season in the riddle.</strong></p>


<p align="center">Under the bells, a carved verse reads:</p>

<p align="center">&quot;I dress the path in copper gold. I light the pumpkins as nights grow cold. Before the snow, after the sun - ring my season and you are done.&quot;</p>

<p align="center">Snowflake, sun or leaf? Your cat paws at an oak leaf caught beneath the door.</p>
